summary: Iteration 5 frontend verification — both deliverables PASS. (1) ReplayScrubber off-by-one fix confirmed: scrub-marker-1, 3, 7, 11, 12, 14 all land on streamIndex=i+1 when clicked from a clean state (restart between clicks). (2) NotificationBell fully functional: badge=7 unread / 9 total on first paint, panel opens/closes (click, outside, ESC), filter chips with correct per-category counts (ALL=9, COMPLIANCE=3, SESSION=2, INTEGRATION=2, AUDIT=1, PLAN=1; 3+2+2+1+1=9 matches ALL), mark-all-read drops badge to zero, per-item dismiss works, category routing verified (Sentinel VETO→/council/live/CW-2040, INTEGRATION→/integrations, PLAN→/admin/tenant, SESSION→/council/live/CW-2041), view-all footer→/compliance/audit, panel closes on every navigation, empty state renders 'No alerts · The council is quiet.' after dismissing all items in a category. No regressions: Dashboard, /council/live/CW-2041 (RadialCommittee + ReplayScrubber + ThoughtStream), /signup, /settings unaffected. Aesthetic remains dark-terminal — no light flashes observed.
critical_code_review_comments: NotificationProvider.jsx · setInterval rotates LIVE_EVENTS every 35s and pushes a duplicate every cycle (id is regenerated each push), so over a long session the feed can grow to the cap of 60 with repeated entries. Consider de-duping on (title+body) or capping at a smaller window.
NotificationBell.jsx · the Phase-3 placeholder string 'Live · WS pending (Phase 3)' is hardcoded copy in the footer; fine for now but flag for removal once the Java/Spring backend lands.

ReplayScrubber.jsx · onTrackDown still uses mousedown on the track itself, while marker uses both mousedown (stopPropagation) + click (setStreamIndex). This works, but mixing mousedown-based seek on the track with click-based seek on markers is slightly inconsistent — consider moving track seek to onClick for symmetry. Functional behavior is now correct.

Iteration-4 carryover: LiveSession.jsx (525 lines) and Onboarding.jsx (476 lines) still over the soft 300-line modular target; Onboarding's SummaryRail/StepDot extraction is still a worthwhile refactor.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 5 deliverables (ReplayScrubber off-by-one fix + functional NotificationBell) are fully verified. Note for future scrubber tests: always click [data-testid='scrub-restart'] between marker assertions, otherwise residual auto-advance during the brief paused→click window can leave streamIndex unchanged (this gave a false 'Marker-12 FAIL' on the first run). Notification seed produces 9 items / 7 unread on first paint, with category split 3/2/2/1/1 (compliance/session/integration/audit/plan). Synthetic LIVE_EVENTS rotation is on a 35s setInterval inside NotificationProvider's useEffect; tests that span >35s will see the count grow. The Sentinel VETO entry is the topmost item in the seed and routes to /council/live/CW-2040; the very first WARN compliance entry routes to /compliance/audit, so be careful with .first selectors — filter to `has_text='Sentinel VETO'` if asserting the VETO route specifically.
rca of the issue: Iteration-4 off-by-one root cause was that the track's mousedown handler (onTrackDown) bubbled before the marker's click handler, causing onSeek to round to the wrong streamIndex on interior markers. Iteration-5 fix added onMouseDown={(ev)=>ev.stopPropagation()} on the marker wrapper at line 139 of ReplayScrubber.jsx, preventing the bubble. Verified empirically — markers 1,3,7,11,12,14 now all land on i+1 when clicked from a paused, restarted state.
